name: optionsKit
description: A typed, validated, introspectable options tree for World of Warcraft addons, bound to getters and setters or to a SettingsKit database, with no renderer.
summary: A typed, validated, introspectable options tree bound to getters or a SettingsKit database, with no renderer.
